name: REA
description: Reverse engineer shipped apps with REA 6.1.0 (morluto/rea, MIT): Electron routes and IPC, APKs, .NET, native binaries. Static tools only; nothing runs the target. REA is not a sandbox: analyse only files you trust. Analysis results go to your agent's model provider.

capabilities.label: REA static analysis
capabilities.description: Reverse engineer a shipped app or file without running it: Electron/JavaScript apps (routes, IPC, preload bridges), packages, .NET assemblies, APKs and network captures. Each call saves REA's full Evidence and answers a short digest.

tools.description: Map a shipped Electron or JavaScript app (an .asar file or an extracted app folder) without running it: windows, preload bridges, IPC channels and handlers, modules. Answers a digest (up to 15 items per kind, with file:line) and the path of the full Evidence bundle; page through a kind with read-evidence.

path.description: The file: absolute, or relative to your working folder.

tools.description: Trace one feature through a shipped JavaScript/Electron app: start from an IPC channel, route, API, module or literal string and follow every static relation to it. Answers what it touches (with file:line) and saves the full Evidence.

path.description: The file: absolute, or relative to your working folder.

value.description: The channel name, route, API, module or text to start from.

match.description: How to match the value (default contains).

tools.description: List every file inside an archive or app package (ZIP, APK, IPA, MSIX, ASAR) with digests and integrity checks, without extracting or running it.

path.description: The file: absolute, or relative to your working folder.

tools.description: Inspect a .NET assembly (DLL or EXE): types, members and native boundaries, without running it.

path.description: The file: absolute, or relative to your working folder.

tools.description: Inspect an Android APK: manifest, permissions, components and classes. Needs JADX set up in REA's settings; the answer says so when it is not.

path.description: The file: absolute, or relative to your working folder.

tools.description: Read a saved network capture (HAR or mitmproxy): requests and responses, with known credentials left out. Recorded URLs are never fetched.

path.description: The file: absolute, or relative to your working folder.

tools.description: Read a saved REA Evidence bundle again: without kind, its digest; with kind (for example ipc-channel or javascript-module), every item of that kind, 100 at a time from offset.

bundle.description: The bundle path an earlier answer gave.

kind.description: A kind from the digest's groups.

settings.label: Tools your agents get
settings.description: Core: the 27 most used tools (about 13k tokens). Full: all 108 static tools (about 104k tokens), which crowds a smaller model's context.

settings.label: Disassembler
settings.description: Which engine opens native programs. Automatic picks the one that is set up.

settings.label: Ghidra folder
settings.description: Absolute path of an extracted Ghidra 12.1.x release (for native programs).

settings.label: Java (JDK) folder
settings.description: Absolute path of a JDK 21 or newer. Leave empty when java is on the PATH.

settings.label: Ghidra start timeout (ms)
settings.description: Raise it for very large programs.

settings.label: JADX MCP JAR
settings.description: Absolute path of a jadx-headless-mcp 0.7.1 JAR (for Android apps).

settings.label: Wakaru command
settings.description: Absolute path of Wakaru 1.13.0 (readable code from a bundle).

settings.label: Python with pwntools
settings.description: Absolute path of a Python that has pwntools 4.15.0 (ELF layout and crash dumps).

settings.label: Unblob command
settings.description: Absolute path of Unblob 26.6.x (firmware), as an alternative to Binwalk.

settings.label: IDA MCP registration
settings.description: Only with your own IDA Pro license: path of your IDA MCP registration JSON.

settings.label: Hopper launcher
settings.description: Only with your own Hopper license: path of its launcher.
